purpose: OVD-457 shared contract fixture. Synthetic identifiers only. The canonical text equals PostgreSQL jsonb::text of the canonical envelope; fingerprint = pg_catalog.encode(pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to(envelope::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex'). jsonb preserves array order, so SQL producers must build sourceFiles and outboundFiles in canonical role order (cad before drawing) to reproduce the fingerprint. Consumers (OVD-458 SQL, OVD-459/461 TypeScript) must reproduce every expectation below.

patternProbes.purpose: Regex-operator sweep. Each value is one or two characters away from a valid value and is rejected only by the named pattern; together they kill every alphabet, quantifier, literal and case-flag mutant of that pattern that is not equivalent. envelope: set at path on the golden envelope, parse fails as envelope_malformed. admissionEvidence: set at path in admittedEvidence, admission fails as admission_evidence_malformed. envelopeRevisionText: the legacy `${id}.v${version}` text does not parse. admissionBinding: the binding field and the resolver's echo of it both take the value, and the shared Xometry admission helper rejects it.
